manifest.name: ud-downs-q4k-lmhead-embed-q4k
manifest.description: unsloth UD-Q4_K_M (V0) as a lower-memory map: the routed expert downs of every layer except 34, 38 and 39 move from Q5_K to Q4_K (kq_rtn), as llama.cpp's own Q4_K_S does, and lm_head (Q6_K) and the token embeddings (Q8_0) move to Q4_K (kq_rtn). Layers 34, 38 and 39 keep unsloth's Q6_K downs, and every gate/up, shared expert, attention and recurrent tensor keeps unsloth's bytes. The downs are a third of the model, so the map is about 1.5 GiB smaller than V0 (searchable 19.0 vs 20.5 GiB); a token reads less of lm_head and of its eight experts' downs, in the format SparkInfer reads fastest, so decode should rise a little. V1 (V0's map by kq_rtn) shows the encoder change itself costs almost nothing (0.0460 vs 0.0450).
